description: This file contains the implementation of the 'MltAnalyzer' class, which is responsible for analyzing memory allocations to identify potential leaks or unusual activity, logging statistics, and managing internal data structures. It interacts with other components such as 'cmaHll', 'cmadHandler', and possibly backtrace handlers, and provides methods for inserting, removing, analyzing, and logging allocation data.

classes.name: MltAnalyzer
classes.description: Class responsible for memory leak detection and analysis, providing methods for inserting, removing, analyzing, and logging memory allocations.

methods.name: void SetFilename(const char * postfix,const char * ext)
methods.description: Sets the filename for logging and backtrace purposes, constructing the filename with a provided postfix and extension.

methods.name: void * Insert(void * caller,int usize,char * file,int line)
methods.description: Inserts a memory allocation record into the internal data structures, optionally collecting backtrace information.

methods.name: void Remove(void * p)
methods.description: Removes a memory allocation record from the internal data structures, handling potential mismatches or memory corruption.

methods.name: HAHeader * GetHAHeader(void * p)
methods.description: Retrieves the internal header associated with a memory pointer.

methods.name: void Analyze()
methods.description: Performs analysis of current memory allocations, compares distributions, logs data, and handles backtrace logging for specific allocations.

methods.name: void Log(int iteration,SLL<IpCmaNode> & common)
methods.description: Logs the list of not deallocated objects with high 'maxIncr' values during analysis.

ctags.name: Insert
ctags.pattern: /^void *MltAnalyzer::Insert(void* caller, int usize, char *file, int line)$/
